description: This 3D model features a pair of white curtains, divided in the center and suspended from a thin, silver rod. The curtains are designed with a pleated effect, showcasing the texture and fold of the fabric. Each curtain panel hangs straight down, with a slightly undulating hemline that adds a touch of softness to the overall presentation. The grommets at the top are clearly visible, indicating a modern style of curtain hanging. The simple white color and clean lines suggest a versatile design that can complement various interior decors. The overall impression is one of neatness and understated elegance.
